"""git_refs: which remote-tracking branch the gate and tier.py trust (NFX-108). One rule, two callers.

review-gate.py imports this file from its own folder; tier.py loads it by path (it is flat next to tier.py in CI and
in the cloud copy, and under ../../../hooks in the repo). Standard library only, and it imports nothing from either
caller. Both callers pass their own `git(args, cwd) -> str` that raises RuntimeError on failure.

Local state only, nothing is fetched. `origin/HEAD` is trusted as `git remote set-head origin -a` set it: a shell user
can move it, so CI (which names the PR base explicitly) is the control.
"""

ORIGIN = "refs/remotes/origin/"


def _resolves(git, cwd, ref, passthrough):
    """True when `ref` names a commit. An error in `passthrough` (a timeout) is raised, not read as 'missing'."""
    try:
        git(["rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref + "^{commit}"], cwd)
        return True
    except passthrough:
        raise
    except RuntimeError:
        return False

CHECK_FILE = ".nousfx/project.toml"
CHECK_TIMEOUT = 1800
CHECK_LOG = "claude-review-check.log"
STAMP_FILE = "claude-review-check-pass"  # in the git dir, written only by `run-check --stamp` (NFX-97)
PROOF_STAMP_FILE = "claude-proof-pass"  # in the git dir, written only by prove.py (NFX-105); the gate never reads it
TESTFAIL_STAMP_FILE = "claude-testfail-pass"  # in the git dir, written only by testfail.py (NFX-190); the gate never reads it
STAMP_KEY = "claude-review-stamp-key"
GIT_ENV_VARS = ("GIT_DIR", "GIT_WORK_TREE", "GIT_INDEX_FILE", "GIT_COMMON_DIR")

BUDGET = 2.0  # seconds for the whole hook
GIT_WAIT = 0.6  # most the "how far behind" question may take
FETCH_EVERY = 600  # seconds between background fetches

"""Tests for git_refs.py: the one default-branch rule the gate and tier.py share (NFX-108)."""
import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import git_refs  # noqa: E402


class Timeout(RuntimeError):
    pass

# origin/HEAD (only when it points at another refs/remotes/origin/ ref), else origin/main, else origin/master.
# An assignment, not a def: the one definition is git_refs.default_ref (NFX-108). `git` is looked up at call time, so a test can patch it.
default_ref = lambda top: load_git_refs().default_ref(git, top, (GitUnavailable,))  # noqa: E731

class TicketCheck(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_step_2_lints_the_proof_lines(self):
        """NFX-208: refused Proof: lines are gaps before coding, not a hand rewrite at Record time."""
        src = text()
        step2 = src[src.index("## Step 2"):src.index("## Step 3")]
        self.assertIn("prove.py lint", step2)
        self.assertIn("refused line", step2)

def _coding_settings():
    """via_agy_call.SETTINGS with file writes and edits allowed: headless agy otherwise runs shell commands and
    reads files outside the workspace, whatever RULES says. Any deny rule added there reaches coding runs too."""
    settings = json.loads(vac.SETTINGS)
    deny = settings["permissions"]["deny"]
    settings["permissions"]["deny"] = [d for d in deny if d not in ("write_file(*)", "edit_file(*)")]
    return json.dumps(settings)

def load_is_doc(path=TIER_PY):
    """review-loop's doc rule (tier.py's is_doc) minus tier.py's built-in risk paths (requirements.txt,
    CMakeLists.txt, .github/), which a deep review must see; or None, with a stderr note, when tier.py cannot be
    loaded (NFX-293)."""
    try:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("tier_for_gemini_review", path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        is_doc, risk_path_hit = module.is_doc, module.risk_path_hit
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - any load failure means no doc rule, so every outside file still stops the run
        sys.stderr.write("Note: could not load tier.py (%s: %s), so docs outside gemini_code_paths stop the run "
                         "too.\n" % (path, type(e).__name__))
        return None
    return lambda name: is_doc(name) and not risk_path_hit(name, ())
